name: 3x3s But No 3x3 in Nepal 2026

venue.name: Adarsha Vidya Mandir
venue.details: Common Hall, Second Floor, High School Section

information: The competition has been canclled due to weather condition, heavy rainfall and flood risk. Please do not visit the venue and stay safe. All regisrations will be fully refunded within 48 hours, please contact the organizers/delegates if there is an issue or delay. If you had not added your registration information in the remarks of your payment, please contact the organizers/delegates to verify your payment and issue the refund. You can find contact details in the [Contact Us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/3x3sButNo3x3inNepal2026#79718-contact-us) tab.
